science_scope: Small real-digit five-target CPU multitask learning: direct specialization of ONE paid shared adapter output, comparing LiME-style diagonal vectors to Mirror 4D structured rotation/shear, strong one-forward independent output heads, and same-code linear scaling. This is NOT official LiME 47-task reproduction, not real LLM, and no native LiME zero-parameter router implemented (role known).
hypothesis: On five supervised useful output functions from the identical physical image and exactly one shared heavy forward, Mirror4 structured adapter-output rotations/shears have lower NLL than a same-four-coefficient native diagonal code in >=4/5 new heldout splits, while native full 32-vector LiME-style scalings and a single-forward five-independent-output-head set the stronger quality/byte/runtime Pareto controls.

data.name: sklearn load_digits 8x8 1797 images
data.inputs: identical images for K=5 output roles
data.role_thresholds: derived from TRAIN-only image IDs, no audit label leakage
data.preprocessing: images /16, train-only mean/std with additive +0.15 stabilizer

split.source_distribution_units: different 75/25 stratified original-image partitions; same dataset across worlds hence correlated

architecture.trunk: two dense layers Linear(64,128) GELU Linear(128,32) GELU, exactly one call per 5-output batch
architecture.peft: shared rank8 adapter out GELU(Linear(32,8)) then Linear(8,32), computed once
architecture.role_bias: Kx2 trainable for all conditional methods
architecture.native_reference: LiME uses ONE shared PEFT and per expert trained elementwise scaling vectors p_j and zero-param routing; LME01 routes externally given output roles and does NOT reproduce native router. Call comparison LiME-style output modulation, not native full LiME.

views.shared_broadcast: one shared head h+δ without role-specific code or bias
views.native_onepass_linearheads: K independent 32→2 heads on h+δ (already one trunk and one shared adapter call)
views.lime_full_diagonal: role output h+δ*exp(p_j), p_j shape Kx32, with role bias
views.lime_linear4: role output h+δ*(1 + B c_j), c_j Kx4 with fixed decoder matrix B 32x4 source-independent, role bias
views.lime_learned_linear4: same native linear4 but shared B itself learned and physically stored
views.mirror_rot4: role output h+Q(c_j)δ; Q is 16 independent planar Givens rotations with angle=(B c_j) per plane, c Kx4 and deterministic B 16x4 from QR; preserved norms; role bias
views.mirror_shear4: role output h+S(c_j)δ; S is 16 block shears (a,b) -> (a+γb,b) with γ=B c_j, role bias. This includes no inverse because applied as readout to shared adapter output, not the exact conjugation of an internal nonlinear FFN.
views.native_givens4_null: ordinary learned Givens output head with same fixed B code and exactly same model function as mirror_rot4, mechanically established by unit test and no claim of novel functionality.

training.shared_initialization: same initial U,V,classifier,adapter for every method in a world
training.train_loss: mean over K binary cross-entropies, each label same weight; no extra balance penalty
training.tuning: none after freeze; do not change LR/steps based on audit data

evaluation.per_world_methods: all seven methods trained for each dev and fresh, same data/init/update stream
metrics: mean over inputs std of K outputs probability
5-way trunk call count and shared adapter call count
actual named deterministic NPZ serialized bytes incl base/adapter/code, metadata and preprocessing
batch128 median P50 and P95 CPU forward latency 20 warmups/80 timed repeats
evaluation.timing: One-thread CPU PyTorch2.10+cpu eager; clock unlocked, thread warmup, batching fixed, no GPU speed extrapolation

success.mechanical: all methods 1 trunk and 1 shared adapter call per K5 batch; Givens transform equals ordinary implementation <=2e-6; no test label leakage
success.Mirror_marginal_PASS: Across >=4/5 fresh dataset splits mirror_rot4 or mirror_shear4 improves *paired* mean NLL by >=0.01 nat/label over native fixed-B same-4-code linear scaling, and achieves mean NLL <=lime_full_diagonal+0.02 with <=0.9 native full-vector member storage. CPU P95<=1.10 full-vector native.
success.Mirror_FAIL: strong one-forward multihead or full diagonal or fixed-B linear4 dominates on quality/storage/latency; source-aligned method is merely a Givens reprametrization; no role-specific learning advantage.
success.UNCERTAIN: 5 correlated splits of one public dataset, output tasks correlated, official LiME router/AutoTopK not reproduced, GPU/native 47-task evidence absent.

data_firewall: Freeze current protocol before any development/fresh runs. Do not inspect audit for model selection. Dev worlds 71/72/73 and fresh 701-705, disjoint from earlier SFM/MAT03 seeds. No alteration of registry scientific status. If dev failure, still run preregistered fresh to diagnose if initiated; no cherry picking.
negative_controls: native one-forward five-head (not K repeated forwards)
one ordinary Givens head equal to Mirror math
shear vs rotation requires quality and runtime checks
uncertainty: Five repeated splits from the same digits dataset are correlated, descriptive min/median/max only, not population confidence. If independent variance components, u_c^2=sum u_i^2, otherwise include covariances. k=2 is descriptive, not certified 95%.
adoption: Full real-liME 47-task independent benchmark, official exact routing, separate heldout task families, strong non-Mirror same-byte controls and GPU P95 before any adoption. Stage0 remains separate UNTESTED scientific MA status.
